crossRefs.note: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master…
Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in…

translations.web: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you given birth to?’ ”
translations.bsb: Woe to him who says to his father, ‘What have you begotten?’ or to his mother, ‘What have you brought forth?’”
translations.kjv: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
translations.asv: Woe unto him that saith unto a father, What begettest thou? or to a woman, With what travailest thou?
